issues.fix: Replace with '(đang xét)' / '(the one being looked at now)' or explain that because edges are processed in nondecreasing weight, the current edge is the heaviest in the cycle.

issues.where: frame explanations claiming stable order for equal weights (classic 1, ties 1, forest 1, already-tree 1, min 1)
